text.content:
A company suburb nobody is paying to maintain.

Region: Santo Domingo (district N). Was: Santo Domingo, the north of Rancho Coronado
Controlled by: 6th Street's patrols; NCPD Precinct 2 is here too, and its captain golfs with the General
The feel of it: Identical houses with identical problems, and Barghest recruiters coming up the highway
Notable locations: NC Psychiatric Health (#45), Rancho Coronado High (#46), Tripple Xtreme (#47), NCPD Precinct 2 (#83), the Commons
Danger: Moderate / Combat. SC 5 (6th Street, Hardened Light). UC 6

The tent cities of 2045 are gone, replaced in the 2050s by company tract housing for Arroyo's workforce. The nomads who rebuilt the city camped here; they've been pushed out past the dam, though some older families stayed. H7, a megabuilding of worker apartments, has been mostly empty since the war. 6th Street knocks on doors on the first of the month.

Recent History

  • 2069: Pacifica's resort collapses; thousands of construction workers come north looking for anywhere to sleep.
  • 2070: The Occupied Zone's checkpoints go up a few kilometers south.

Places

  • NC Psychiatric Health (#45). SC 8. Where MaxTac's survivors and the city's broken minds end up. Its therapy ward is one of the best anywhere; its lockdown ward one of the worst.
  • Rancho Coronado High (#46). SC 5. 6th Street recruits in the parking lot, Barghest at the gate.
  • Tripple Xtreme (#47). SC 3: 6th Street. A strip-mall club and black-market gun counter.
  • The Commons. SC 4. A dead shopping center turned flea market; Barghest sells surplus here on weekends.

Getting There

NCART: Rancho Coronado N., Ash St (Crosstown).

Turf

6th Street.

People

  • Captain Harlan Mbeki (Solo 5, NCPD). Precinct 2's captain.
  • Ma Ferro (Nomad 4). The last nomad matriarch in Rancho Coronado, running a garage and a soup kitchen from one lot.
  • Sergeant Kade (Solo 6, Barghest). A recruiter with a friendly smile and a list of everyone 6th Street has hurt.

Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.11
